# Locaura

> Locaura is a social media growth agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, helping businesses build brand value through content strategy, short-form video (reels), creative direction, and a strong digital presence.

Locaura is run by founder Yashdeep and works with businesses that want consistent, professional content instead of one-off posts. Services span content strategy, reel production, creative direction, social media growth management, and premium video production, sold as monthly growth packages or one-time premium production packages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.locaura.online/index.html): Overview of Locaura, why content matters for modern brands, and how the agency works.
- [Services](https://www.locaura.online/services.html): Detailed breakdown of the five core services — content strategy, reel production, creative direction, social media growth, and premium video production.
- [Packages](https://www.locaura.online/packages.html): Pricing for monthly content growth packages and one-time premium production packages, plus add-ons and FAQ.
- [About](https://www.locaura.online/about.html): Founder story, company values, and the step-by-step process of working with Locaura.
- [Contact](https://www.locaura.online/contact.html): Ways to reach Locaura — WhatsApp, phone, email, or a contact form — and what happens after reaching out.
